limits: Desired state is in-memory local intent, not durability. Acquire is O(1) without payload copy/allocation; edits merge O(current entries) pointer vectors and retain unchanged entries. Caller-owned old snapshots can pin old allocations.

Replay is a caller-driven component with one native Future and original shared deadline. Automatic factories/backoff/reconnect, live desired-set reconciliation and Sentinel/Cluster routing are not delivered by this component. Shard batches stay within one cached normative CRC16 slot; no endpoint selection or MOVED following is implemented.
Restoring Pub/Sub names cannot replay messages missed while offline; delivery remains at-most-once.

Private selected subscriber mode adds8 bytes; feature-off mode, client/request/control/entry and old public layouts stay unchanged. The claim token is borrowed only during native admission, never retained by requests.

Performance remains a closed-loop component baseline on Windows and WSL. Snapshot percentiles cover whole32-operation batches; edits are unbatched. No per-operation snapshot tail is inferred by division.
Every raw sample and failed noise gate remains. Only joint unchanged3% MAD/6% central-span qualification can accept old/current budgets of5% throughput loss and10% P99 increase.
Actual replay recovery latency distribution, CPU/RSS, fixed-arrival mixed workloads, pinned/upstream/native-Linux and>=72h production acceptance remain open. Four-library scope remains developing.
